coverage_notes: Completed 12 targeted web searches covering sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, disaster-related emergency food distribution cancellations or suspensions, abrupt pantry/food-bank service closure or major access reduction, and official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions. Results were stale, outside the bounded interval, outside the U.S., or non-qualifying; no new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified. Production collection remains authoritative.
